description: This Java class defines a custom data type LongFreeTextDatatype for OpenMRS, representing free-text stored as a CLOB in the database. It implements methods for saving, retrieving, and validating the data, as well as handling references to stored text.

classes.name: LongFreeTextDatatype
classes.description: A custom datatype implementation for storing free-text values as CLOBs within the OpenMRS platform, supporting save, retrieve, and validate operations.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets configuration options for the datatype; currently does nothing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the provided string value into the database as a CLOB, returning its UUID reference.

methods.name: getReferenceStringForValue
methods.description: Returns a reference string for the given value; in this case, throws UnsupportedOperationException.

methods.name: fromReferenceString
methods.description: Retrieves the stored value given its UUID reference.

methods.name: getTextSummary
methods.description: Provides a text summary or placeholder for the stored value, using localized message.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the provided string value, ensuring it is not null.
